name: designly
description: Designly is a commercial Art Direction and Design Neural Mesh plugin with 14 focused Skills, 9 custom Codex agents, Taste Engine, Reference Memory, bounded-edit sanitization, Arabic RTL direction, and independent Visual QA.

interface.longDescription: Designly v4.1.0 turns commercial art direction into a network of 14 focused Skills and 9 bounded Codex agents led by Designly Director. It combines creative strategy, brand intelligence, evidence-backed Taste Engine analysis, local-first Reference Memory, composition and typography preflight, photography and manipulation craft, Arabic RTL direction, campaign DNA, provider-aware prompt compilation, and independent Visual QA. The Edit Sanitizer converts annotation-guided inpainting and local correction notes into typed bounded EditContracts before execution, rejects ambiguous targets or global-restyle leakage, protects approved source checkpoints, and routes collateral-change failures back to the smallest responsible node.
defaultPrompt: Art-direct this campaign end-to-end, using specialist review and strict design gates.
Sanitize these annotation notes before editing the image and protect non-target content.
Review this visual critically and route only the smallest necessary correction.
